purpose: diagnose PR35 rapid switching without cache-capacity mismatch
fixture: synthetic in-memory API/Firestore-compatible data only; no real Notes or session

conditions.auth: already authenticated synthetic fixture; auth/startup excluded from note-switch interval
conditions.measurement: capture click event; final title/text assignment; two requestAnimationFrames after title assignment; revision fetch start/end separately
conditions.scope: main and candidate source assets, same fixture handler and generated data

reasons: Rotated across 20 notes, exceeding candidate's 12-note/1 MiB content-cache bound while main contentCache had no equivalent bound.
Timed three sequential Playwright locator.click calls and final title wait, not last-click-to-editor paint.

limitations: Synthetic NAS headless browser measurements; not Vercel runtime, S25 Ultra, or iPad.
Three Playwright clicks are sequential; per-click paint and final-click-to-paint are separately reported.
The 100 ms cached-note and 300 ms warm-list goals remain unmet in the broader benchmark; this targeted profile does not change those results.
decision: retain the frontend-only candidate as release-worthy based on the controlled three-note result; Production was not changed in this task.
